definitions.eligible_p1_p2: P1 or P2, category in review.confidence's non-security list, id not starting SEC- or DEP- (the eligibility rule without its reviewer test)
definitions.credited_to_security_reviewer: eligible findings whose reviewers include a name containing 'security'; review.confidence and review.dedup skip them
definitions.dedup_candidate_pairs: the pairs flow-s1-dedup.sh would ask about, by its candidate rule at 932602d5 (reviewer lists not identical; error-handling sub-types accepted), over the run's findings as converted for the site scripts
definitions.dedup_candidate_pairs_old_rule: the same, by the candidate rule at 6aa8797b (reviewer lists with no reviewer in common), which this pilot's pilot-gate.json used
definitions.findings: this pilot's findings in findings/, made by sessions with the plugin at 6aa8797b; only the candidate rule is newer
